en: Changed plan mode in the desktop app's Code tab and VS Code to ask for approval instead of refusing when no auto mode safety check can judge a command, for plans entered from Manual or Accept edits
zh: 桌面应用 Code 标签页和 VS Code 中的计划模式：当没有自动模式安全检查能判断某条命令时，对于从 Manual 或 Accept edits 进入的计划，现在会请求批准而不是拒绝
